context_diary: The Tenant Platform contains 10,000 total accounts with a hierarchical structure where agents manage user accounts. The system uses role-based account types (ADMIN, AGENT, USER) with agents having "_agent" suffix naming convention. Account lookup requires omitting the "type" parameter to retrieve all accounts, as filtering by specific types like "AGENT" or "USER" may return empty results. The hierarchy management tool uses traverse_hierarchy with "children" direction to find assigned accounts under an agent. The system limits result sets to 50-100 records by default to prevent overload, with total_match counts indicating full dataset size.
